systems.platform: 1,760 km terrestrial fibre: 1,140 km Phase 1 in commercial operation since February 2019, 620 km Phase 2 completed March 2020
systems.owner: State asset company SPIN owns it; private wholesale operator Axione manages it under a PPP
systems.tiers: Connects 26 cities to Libreville and reaches the borders of Congo, Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea; open-access wholesale network, no local government office said to be on it

systems.system: National datacenter, Computer Security Incident Response Center and public-key infrastructure platform
systems.owner: Government of Gabon, financing requested from the African Development Bank
systems.tiers: Requested, not built: to sit in the communes of Franceville and Ntoum, with over 2,000 km of further fibre links in underserved areas

note: World Bank completion report on the national backbone: local governments and municipalities appear only as stakeholders coordinated with and involved in project management and land provision. It states no local government office as connected.
